subject: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery & security review - Nebula Systems
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nebulasys.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery & security review - Nebula Systems

Hi Alex -

Great to meet earlier - thanks for the productive discovery. Per our call, I put together a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the security review / SOC 2 package milestone so we have clear owners, deliverables, and target dates. See highlights below and the attached MAP draft.

Quick recap / ask:
- Goal: Complete security review and delivery of SOC 2 questionnaire + evidence package to support your vendor risk process.
- Target contract signature: July 22, 2026 (aligns with procurement windows you mentioned).

Draft MAP milestones (security-focused):
1) Deliver SOC 2 questionnaire (Redwood) - due: 2026-06-29 - owner: Redwood (Marissa) - dependency: none
2) Evidence list & sample artifacts (Redwood) - due: 2026-06-29 - owner: Redwood (Marissa) - dependency: initial artifacts collected internally by Redwood; will indicate where Nebula needs to verify/accept
3) Nebula completes questionnaire & uploads requested evidence - due: 2026-07-06 - owner: Nebula Security (Alex/Mari) - dependency: internal resource allocation
4) Vendor security review (Nebula) & call for clarifications - week of 2026-07-13 - owner: Nebula Security; Redwood to attend and respond
5) Procurement review & contract redlines - complete by: 2026-07-20 - owner: Nebula Procurement / Redwood Legal
6) Target: Contract signature / PO issued - 2026-07-22 - owner: Procurement

Dependencies / open items:
- Confirmation of scope (production vs non-prod) for SOC 2 artifacts
- Access to any required logs or test accounts for evidence validation (if needed)
- SSO/SCIM or KMS requirements that may impact contract language

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll send the SOC 2 questionnaire + evidence checklist by EOD today (attached).
- Please confirm you want the security review scheduled the week of 7/13 or earlier - you mentioned availability around early July.
- Loop in Mari (CISO) and procurement contact if not already included so we can align dates.

Attachments: Nebula_Systems_MAP_Draft_0625.pdf (MAP draft)

Thanks - and happy to jump on a 30m follow-up if helpful.
—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0182

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nebulasys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mari Sanchez <mari.sanchez@nebulasys.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery & security review - Nebula Systems

Marissa -

Thanks for the clear summary and the MAP draft. Appreciate the timeline. A few quick items from our side: 

- Please include the SOC 2 questionnaire and an evidence checklist - if possible we’d like the evidence list to call out exact artifact examples (syslog export, SSO config screenshots, change control docs).
- I’ll bring this to Mari (cc’d) - she wants to do an initial vendor-security review the week of July 6 (preferred) or July 13 at latest. Can you support a review/call on July 6?
- Procurement asked if we can aim to have redlines submitted by July 18 to keep the July 22 signature target - otherwise we push into the next cycle.

Also: can you confirm whether the SOC 2 scope covers production systems? We need that noted for our internal risk scoring.

If you can send the questionnaire/evidence pack today as mentioned, we’ll triage and get back with a rough ETA for completion.

Thanks,
Alex
Senior Security Engineer, Nebula Systems
alex.johnson@nebulasys.com

Marissa -

Thanks - received the package and MAP. We’ll: 
1) Triage the questionnaire internally and assign a point of contact for evidence collection (I’ll confirm name by EOD tomorrow).
2) Schedule an internal vendor assessment for July 6 and will invite Redwood for a brief 30-45m Q&A if that still works for you.
3) Confirm procurement timeline - we’ll aim for your July 18 redline deadline to hit the July 22 sign date.

A couple of clarifying asks: 
- Confirm again that scope includes production systems (Alex flagged this).
- If we need system architecture diagrams or a short runbook for incident response, send those to procurement/security mailbox procurement@nebulasys.com.

Point of contact for evidence collection: I’ll confirm name tomorrow (likely our Security Ops lead).

Appreciate the clear MAP - happy to proceed on the proposed timeline.

Regards,
Mari Sanchez
